pivotal_result: Recursion statement on the SYCAMORE trial of REC-994 in symptomatic cerebral cavernous malformation (trial registration NCT05085561): Recursion decided to discontinue the trial. Early data after one year on REC-994 suggested some promising trends with the 400 mg dose, but these positive trends were not sustained in the long-term extension, whether patients stayed on 400 mg, switched from 200 mg to 400 mg, or switched from placebo to 400 mg. Further analysis of the long-term extension data showed no significant improvements in MRI results or functional outcomes, with results similar to what would be expected without any treatment. Statement published 2025-05-05.
reason_class: Discontinued after extension efficacy not sustained
